subject.title: Feature/Fix: Add conservative lineage safety and promotion controls

question: Should CodexBar adopt this four-PR lineage architecture as the future authoritative accounting path, or prefer the narrower identity and cache-invalidation approach in https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118?
rationale: Both approaches target the same fork-accounting failure, but they differ substantially in scope, rollout policy, long-term scanner architecture, and compatibility exposure; tests cannot determine the intended permanent product boundary.

options.title: Continue the lineage stack
options.body: Require exact-head runtime proof, review and merge https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2155 through https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2158 in order, and retain legacy authority until promotion is explicitly approved.

options.title: Prefer the narrow repair
options.body: Land the identity and cache-invalidation work from https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2118 and pause this broader accounting rearchitecture until a separate architecture proposal is sponsored.

options.title: Pause both approaches
options.body: Keep the current production containment behavior while collecting more affected-corpus evidence before selecting a permanent cross-file lineage design.

recommendation.title: Continue the lineage stack
recommendation.body: Require exact-head runtime proof, review and merge https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2155 through https://github.com/steipete/CodexBar/pull/2158 in order, and retain legacy authority until promotion is explicitly approved.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice determines the repository's permanent accounting architecture and rollout policy rather than requiring a mechanical code correction.
